failure_patterns.pattern: wrong_domain_refiltering: Hotel-only reply ('Around 30', '5 star and kids club') made the agent also re-filter cached flight keys with the earlier class, and re-pass old stars and amenities.

rejected_edits.content: - Criteria to pass to filter_*: ONLY the constraints introduced in the LAST user turn. Every earlier turn (its search and each filter) is already inside the cached entry, so never re-pass an earlier cuisine, dietary flag, stars, neighborhood, amenity, budget, class or dates, whether or not the summary text happens to list it. A budget reply on a restaurants entry is `budget=<n>` only. Never call filter_* with only prior_results.
rejected_edits.target: - Criteria to pass to filter_*: the constraints introduced in the LAST user turn, plus any earlier-stated constraint that the CACHE summary text ("Additionally filtering for ..." / search description) does not show as applied. Do NOT repeat filters or search parameters the summary already lists. Never call filter_* with only prior_results.

rejected_edits.content: -1. FLIGHT REPLIES = ONE BLOCK PER FLIGHT LEG. This fires ONLY when the user's LAST message itself contains a flight word (a class such as 'economy'/'first'/'business', an airline code, a departure/arrival time, or a ticket price) or answers an assistant question that asked about flight class, airline, time or ticket price. It NEVER fires for stars, amenities, neighborhood, a per-night hotel budget, a bare number after a hotel question, or any restaurant/attraction reply. A class chosen in an earlier turn is already in the flight keys' summaries, so those keys stay untouched: zero flight lines, even when flight keys sit in CACHE next to 'hotels'.
rejected_edits.target: -1. FLIGHT REPLIES = ONE BLOCK PER FLIGHT KEY. This applies only when the assistant's last question or the user's last message is about flight class, airline, flight time or ticket price (a class word such as 'economy'/'first', an airline code, 'under N' answering a flight-price question), even if a 'hotels' key is also in CACHE.
